tools.name: balance
tools.description: Show the account's plan, when it ends, and exports used/left this month.

tools.name: products
tools.description: Plan catalog: Student and Pro (personal), Group and Class (Telegram chats), with prices and ids for topup_link.

tools.name: render_flowchart
tools.description: Render source code into a ДСТУ 19.701-90 (ГОСТ/ISO 5807) flowchart. Returns a PNG image by default (jpeg/webp/gif/gif_anim also come back as images; svg/typst/excalidraw/html as text; pdf/docx/visio as a download link or base64). Requires the Pro plan; each exported file counts toward the plan's mon

tools.name: topup_link
tools.description: Get a payment link for a plan (pass the plan id from products).
